head_commit.message:
Design: apply Impeccable — remove 13 kicker-above-heading patterns, fix contrast + text-size + flat-hierarchy

Adopted https://impeccable.style as the design QA system (installed in
.github/skills + PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md context). Detector found 15
anti-patterns on live pages; all fixed:

- kicker-above-heading (13×, Home/MyRequests/MyCompanyInbox×4/Premium×2/
  ReferralRequest): removed the tracked uppercase label blocks; info
  merged into headings/meta; spacing migrated to the headings (mt-6).
- gray-on-color (Premium): slate-700 body on blue-50 → slate-900.
- undersized-ui-text (wall): 10px functional share labels → 11px floor.
- flat-type-hierarchy (wall): removed the 10px step so the ramp has
  contrast (11/12/14/16/19+).
- layout-transition (sidebar.tsx, unused component): left as-is — not
  user-facing; noted for removal when shadcn sidebar is pruned.

Verified: check clean, build exit 0, full suite 287 passed / 5 skipped.

workflow_runs.display_title: Fix: boot-time schema auto-reconcile — app self-heals missing DB columns

head_commit.message:
Fix: boot-time schema auto-reconcile — app self-heals missing DB columns

The /wall 500 root cause was a schema.ts/live-DB drift
(companyOpportunities.compensation was committed but never applied to the
live Azure MySQL). SSH into the container is blocked and DATABASE_URL is an
unreadable secret, so the server now reconciles its own schema at boot:

- server/schemaReconcile.ts: idempotent DESIRED_COLUMNS list (checked via
  information_schema; ALTERs only what's missing). Currently covers
  companyOpportunities.compensation, jobs.compensation,
  referralRequests.savedAt. Non-fatal on failure (log + continue).
- server/_core/index.ts: fire-and-forget reconcileSchema() at boot;
  /api/health now reports schemaReconciled.
- server/schemaReconcile.test.ts: 5 tests (idempotent, skip-existing,
  apply-missing, non-fatal on DB error, health flag).

Verified: check clean, build exit 0, full suite 287 passed / 5 skipped.
On next deploy the container boots, applies the missing column, and /wall
serves pay ranges end to end.

head_commit.message:
Fix: /wall 500s — companyOpportunities.compensation missing from live DB

The live browser audit (scripts/live-flow-audit.mjs, 19/19 checks) surfaced one
real defect: GET /api/opportunities returned 500, breaking the /wall page.
Root cause: the earlier 9d383cb fix added jobs.compensation + referralRequests.
savedAt to the live DB but MISSED companyOpportunities.compensation, which
listPublicCompanyOpportunities() (and the owner list) select.

Fixes:
- server/db.ts: listPublicCompanyOpportunities + listCompanyOpportunities now
  degrade gracefully when the compensation column is absent (catch → retry
  without compensation) so the pages never 500, even pre-migration.
- scripts/apply-missing-columns.mjs: idempotent reconciler (checks
  information_schema, ALTERs only missing columns) covering
  companyOpportunities.compensation, jobs.compensation, referralRequests.savedAt.
- drizzle/0035_company_opportunities_compensation.sql: MySQL 8.0 ALTER.

Verified: pnpm check clean, build exit 0, opportunityWall/postOpportunity/
integration 19/19 pass.

workflow_runs.display_title: Fix: referrer OTP flow lands on the company inbox — missing DB column…

head_commit.message:
Fix: referrer OTP flow lands on the company inbox — missing DB columns + stale web bundle

User-reported: after 'I give referrals' → work email → OTP, the app bounced
back to the 'Continue with work email' screen instead of showing the company's
referral requests.

Root causes (both fixed):
1. Missing DB columns: jobs.compensation (and referralRequests.savedAt was
   already added ad-hoc) were in schema.ts but never applied to the Azure
   MySQL database, so /api/company-referrals/inbox 500'd on every load
   ('Unknown column jobs.compensation'), and inboxReady never became true —
   the UI silently fell back to the sign-in gate. Columns added live;
   idempotent migration 0031 committed for fresh environments.
2. Stale web bundle: production served an old index build that predated the
   server-session auth fix, so isSignedIn stayed false after OTP. Fresh
   build deployed (index-Csxcj6Ep.js).

Full journey verified in a real browser on production: /referrer → email →
OTP → auto-redirect to /inbox listing ETHOSLIFE.COM · REF-1007 with Review
candidate / Save for later. Full-suite drift check added
(.openclaw/tmp/schema-drift.cjs) reports NO SCHEMA DRIFT.

UX: referrer impact dashboard, seeker next-steps panel, post-decision guidance

Three visible flow upgrades:

1. NEW /referrer/impact (ReferrerImpact.tsx) — referrer impact dashboard:
   stat cards (accepted/pending/declined/unread/credits), recent referrals
   list, empty state, error retry. Backed by new GET /api/referrer/impact-

   email. Linked from AccountMenu ('My impact', work-email-gated).
